images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Side-view action puzzle inside a square rotating kitchen module on a space station. The module fills the center: a thick rounded steel frame with a glowing cyan neon rim, an 8x8 grid interior of dark indigo panels, steel counters whose top edges glow cyan and magenta, a stove with an amber burner under a steel pot of bubbling orange soup. The module has just rotated 90 degrees clockwise: a big cyan motion arc sweeps over the frame, a carrot falls straight toward the pot with a white motion streak, a tomato splashes into the soup throwing droplets, an egg rests on a shelf, mushroom, onion, shrimp and noodle block lie where gravity pushed them, orange soup droplets float. Left: a round porthole with Earth's blue curve and a sunrise flare above a gravity dial with a lime arrow and Q/E rotate keys. Right: white paper order tickets on a rail with ingredient icons and check marks. HUD: neon sign '중력 주방', '러시 타임 02:14', '콤보 ×4', ticket '토마토 달걀탕'. Glossy stylized 2.5D illustration, deep navy, neon cyan and magenta, warm orange soup, soft bloom, fine grain.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same square space-station kitchen module, now rotated 180 degrees after two careless turns, bathed in red emergency light with a rotating alarm beam and yellow-black hazard stripes around the frame. The steel pot hangs upside down at the top of the module, and a thick glossy orange soup blob is glued to the ceiling around it, long soup drips hanging down with droplets. All ingredients — tomatoes, egg, onion, mushroom, shrimp, noodle block — have tumbled into a heap along the bottom wall, a carrot stuck in the soup. A red banner across the top reads '천장 수프 경보 · 클레임 접수'. Right: order tickets stamped with big red '클레임' stamps, and a pink holographic customer face frowning in a scanline window with a speech bubble '제 수프가 왜 천장에 있죠?'. Left: porthole showing Earth's night side with city lights and a green aurora. HUD timer '00:09' in red, tip counter dropping '−320'. Glossy stylized 2.5D illustration, crimson and magenta alarm palette against deep purple-navy, orange soup glow, bloom, grain, chaotic comedic panic. Composition constraint: keep exactly the same side-view framing as screen A — the square 8x8 grid kitchen module with its thick neon-rimmed steel frame centered, seen flat from the front, rotated 180 degrees so the pot and soup are on the module's ceiling row and ingredients on the bottom row; not a first-person corridor view; no brand text like "K-FOOD".
